_comment: WP-2 fixture — RAW Selaras live-FG rows (assumed shape only; nothing recorded).
PascalCase ON PURPOSE (A2, casing unverified). The two ACP-4MM Black Galaxy rolls
sum to 4,168 lembar, matching PRD §5A. Row 4 has an unreadable qty and row 5 has
no serial: both must degrade, never abort the page. Row 6 carries SEPARATOR-
AMBIGUOUS quantities (A22): '1.234' is 1234 in id notation and 1.234 in en, so
under SELARAS_NUMBER_FORMAT=auto it must be refused and counted, never guessed.
Row 7 carries NON-FINITE numerics (X11): NaN / Infinity are legal Postgres
numeric values, so they must be rejected at the adapter, never written through.

rows._why: unreadable qty must become 0, never NaN (numeric column would reject NaN)
no serial — unkeyable, dropped and counted
A22: both quantities are separator-ambiguous. Under auto they are refused (qty -> 0, qty_m2 -> null), counted, and logged once per run.

X11: 'NaN'::numeric and 'Infinity'::numeric are LEGAL in Postgres and the schema does not forbid them in th/p/l. One stored there would make erp_sku_key() render 'NaN' while canonicalSkuKey() renders '-', silently desynchronising that SKU. None may be written.
